name: SPT-CL J0426-5416 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0426-5416, a massive galaxy cluster found by the South Pole Telescope, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj04265416-hubble
story: A massive gathering of galaxies picked out by the South Pole Telescope. Hubble's view helps reveal how the brightest galaxy at a cluster's core builds up through mergers with its neighbors.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0426-5416 is one of the South Pole Telescope galaxy clusters imaged in Hubble program 15307
The program's clusters were identified via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect and are massive clusters
The program studies the growth of brightest cluster galaxies through mergers, strong lensing, and lensed background galaxies
